subject: Deployment fit questions & proposed PoC charter for TruCare
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason@trucarehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment fit questions & proposed PoC charter for TruCare

Hi Jason —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps so we keep momentum:

Recap of needs from today's discovery:
- Throughput / latency: production p95 target ~300ms for conversational API (peak traffic expected 80–120 qps).
- Data posture: PHI in transit and at rest — HIPAA required; audit logs and KMS required.
- Preference: TruCare prefers a Private VPC or on-prem approach for patient data, but open to Dedicated capacity if there are infra blockers.
- Key stakeholders: Jason (Eng), Priya (Security), Sarah (PM) — we'll need architecture and compliance sign-off for any trial.

Proposed PoC goals (6-week timebox):
1) Integration: demo a minimal end-to-end call path for notes generation from EHR extracts.
2) Performance: demonstrate p95 <350ms and baseline cost-per-200k tokens.
3) Security: run a short checklist (KMS, VPC peering or private link, access logs) and hand back evidence for your compliance team.
4) Rollback/operational play: canary routing to Hosted API fallback if private capacity is unhealthy.

Open questions for you (helps scope the deployment mode):
- Do you require data to remain on TruCare-managed infrastructure (on-prem) or is a customer VPC in AWS acceptable?
- Any constraints on egress / peering (we'll need a networking contact to confirm IP allowlists)?
- Expected peak concurrency and retention policy for logs?

Attachments: I attached a blank PoC charter template that we can fill out together and the security questionnaire you mentioned.

Proposed next steps:
- Jason / Priya: confirm VPC vs on-prem preference and suggest two dates next week for a 30-min kickoff.
- Ben / Marcus: we will prepare a short delta sheet (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) with estimated TCO and infra asks.

If you prefer, we can start the PoC on Dedicated capacity to parallelize security work and then migrate traffic to Private VPC once networking is in place.

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: trial-charter-template.pdf
From: Jason Lee <jason@trucarehealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@trucarehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Deployment fit questions & proposed PoC charter for TruCare

Kim — thanks for the clear summary and template. A few answers and clarifications from our side:

- Data residency: we operate in US-only regions for now, so a Redwood-hosted solution in the US or a Private VPC in our AWS account both work. On-prem would be preferable for long-term, but for the PoC we're fine with Private VPC in our AWS.
- Security: Priya is copied — she'll send the completed security questionnaire (attached) and a short list of compliance evidence we need (SOC2, encryption-at-rest details, retention controls).
- Network: we have a network engineer (Tom Walsh) who will want to join the tech kickoff to verify peering and NAT requirements.
- Timeline: aiming to start the PoC week of Oct 25; 6 weeks sounds good.

Cost question: can you give a ballpark delta between Dedicated capacity and Private VPC for a trial of this size? Also, if we start on Dedicated, how disruptive is a move to Private VPC later?

I'll get Priya's notes back by EOD tomorrow. Proposed kickoff: Tue Oct 26 or Wed Oct 27, 10–11am PT.

—Jason

Attachment: tru-care-security-questions.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Deployment fit questions & proposed PoC charter for TruCare

FW team — Jason at TruCare confirmed US-only and is fine starting the PoC in a customer VPC (preferred) or Dedicated. Priya will return the security questionnaire.

Please action:
1) Ben: prepare a 1-page delta (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) with ballpark monthly costs for trial scale and notes on migration friction. Target: EOD Wed (13 Oct).
2) Marcus: can you scope the network checklist (peering, IPs, NAT, TLS termination, KMS key flows) and estimate the time to stand up a Private VPC trial? If we start on Dedicated, note what needs to change for migration.

I'll propose Oct 26 kickoff once we have your delta and a calendar invite with Tom (TruCare).

Thanks — Kim

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Deployment fit questions & proposed PoC charter for TruCare

Perfect — I'll draft the Hosted/Dedicated/Private delta and include a rough monthly cost band, typical SLA differences, and migration notes.

Quick notes:
- Migration path: starting on Dedicated then shifting to Private VPC is low-friction if model versioning and serialised KV caches are preserved; we'll likely need a brief sync window and DNS swap.
- Private VPC asks: customer needs a VPC peering or PrivateLink; we will require an IAM role for the KMS policy and an S3 bucket for logs that we can read-with-audit; estimate ~2–3 full engineering days to validate networking and KMS integration on our side.

I'll have the one-pager to you by EOD Wed and can join the kickoff on Oct 26.

—Ben
